messages:
leo: Starting a small spike: 'TokenPath Recon' panel that shows per-query-path cost + amortized prefetch/warmup. Need quick alignment on telemetry shape and export semantics.

anya: Nice. Two quick constraints: keep per-event tiny, and exports must be reproducible for finance audits. Recommend qpath_id ref + separate lineage/prefetch docs.

derek: For amortized warmup math we should expose the parameters used in the export so audits can re-run calculations. e.g., amortized_cost = total_prefetch_tokens / reuse_window_sec. Put reuse_window in export metadata.

frida: UX: show primary number = per-invocation billed tokens. Offer an expandable line for "amortized prefetch (apportioned)". Internal users default to apportioned; external default to credited owner. Tooltip explains difference.

leo: Telemetry sketch: per-request event = qpath_id (required), tokens_in (required), final_sku (optional), cache_hit (bool optional). Prefetch event = prefetch_id, qpath_id, origin_sku, prefetch_tokens, prefetch_key_hash, ttl_seconds. Keep keys hashed.

anya: Sampling policy: exact for <=1h window, 1m rollups up to 24h, reservoir sampling beyond. Exports: offer two modes: dynamic (live estimates) and snapshot (immutable, admin-only). Snapshot stores params + computed rows.

derek: CSV spec (draft): columns = reconciliation_id, qpath_id, billed_sku, credited_cost_usd, apportioned_cost_usd, amortized_prefetch_tokens, direct_tokens, amortization_params, sample_method, confidence_pct. reconciliation_id for immutables.

frida: Simulation widget: slider to reassign X% traffic between SKUs and a reusable 'reuse_window' knob. Show projected monthly delta and confidence band derived from sample variance (7d baseline).

leo: Implementation note: prefer storing lineage/prefetch docs off-band keyed by qpath_id to avoid inflating per-event sizes. Ingest shim materializes lineage on first-seen qpath_id.

anya: Indexing caveat: qpath_id should be compact (64-bit hex) and go to a low-cardinality index path. Add opt-out/redaction for public logs.

derek: On rollouts: mark amortized rows as 'stale' when routing policy or SKU mapping changes. UI should show a 'stale' flag and allow recompute-with-simulation.

frida: Export UX: default CSV includes both credited and apportioned columns; admin can select which to label primary. Include export_metadata columns with exact sampling windows and amortization params for reproducibility.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: telemetry schema "tokenpath-recon-v1" staged to canary 'canary-phi' in 2m :rocket:

leo: I'll draft a short RFC with telemetry contract, export API POST /internal/exports/tokenpaths, snapshot behavior, and UI sketches. If anyone objects to apportioned default internal, speak now.

anya: +1 apportioned default internal.

derek: +1

frida: +1. Also please include an example SQL query for auditors in the RFC.

leo: Will do. Filing RFC after this thread. Thanks all!
